successors.name: Akkadian Empire
successors.text: 'the Upper Land: Mari, Iarmuti, and Ebla' claimed by Sargon

ledger.x: 3000 BCE: the first kingdom of Ebla.
2400 BCE: Ebla at its greatest extent.
2300 BCE: the war ends with Ebla's destruction.
2300 BCE: palace G burns and the first kingdom ends.

wars.name: Ebla–Mari war
wars.outcome: Sa'umu of Mari took Eblaite cities; Kun-Damu defeated Mari (mid-25th century); Ebla paid tribute under Igrish-Halam while Iblul-Il invaded the middle Euphrates; 'Ebla recovered under Irkab-Damu in about 2340 BC and counter-attacked Mari'; Ibbi-Sipish won near…

certainty.note: 'Half the size of modern Syria' bounded by named towns (Ursa'um, Damascus area, Haddu) and vassal kingdoms; no line is drawn on any page.
